name: Chroma icon
description: Rainbow-cycles your icon colors, glow, trails and fire. Pick exactly what is affected in the settings.

profile-snapshot.name: Rainbow color on my profile (what others see)
profile-snapshot.description: When the game uploads your profile, it saves the closest palette color to the current rainbow color. Others see one fixed color (the server cannot animate), and it changes each time your profile updates. Your own saved colors are not changed.

title-palette.name: Rainbow palette color (for players with the mod)

show-rainbow-palette.name: Show the Rainbow palette color as a moving rainbow
show-rainbow-palette.description: Any player whose saved icon color is the Rainbow palette color number (below) is drawn as a moving rainbow. Only works for players who have this mod.

rainbow-id.name: Rainbow palette color number
rainbow-id.description: Which palette color counts as the rainbow. Players WITHOUT the mod just see that normal palette color, and anyone using it looks rainbow to mod users. Everyone with the mod must use the same number.

profile-rainbow-id.name: Upload my profile with the Rainbow palette color
profile-rainbow-id.description: Instead of the nearest palette color, your profile upload uses the Rainbow palette color number, so mod users see a moving rainbow on your account. Others see that palette color.

glow.name: Glow
glow.description: Glow outline color. Turn this off if anything looks wrong, then tell me what changed.

color-1-offset.name: Color 1 hue offset
color-1-offset.description: 0 = Color 1 matches Color 2. 0.5 = opposite side of the rainbow.

speed.name: Speed (cycles per second)
speed.description: How fast the colors cycle. 0.3 is about one full loop every 3 seconds.

previews.name: Icon kit and profile page
previews.description: Show the rainbow on the icon previews in the icon kit and on your profile.

title-effects.name: Effects (in levels, use the Color 2 rainbow)

ship-fire.name: Ship and UFO fire / click particles

palette-sync.name: Sync nearest palette color (Globed)
palette-sync.description: Also sets your real saved Color 2 + glow to the closest palette color, so mods that send your icon colors (like Globed) can pick it up. Looks steppy to others. Your original color is restored when you turn this off.
